newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions bonds worth 1.3 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions bonds worth 1.3 bln rupees.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said it had auctioned six-month maturity short-term federal bonds worth more than 1.3 billion rupees on Monday at a weighted average yield of 17.0676 percent per annum.
The bank received bids worth a total of 2,959.01 million rupees, of which bids for 1,339.01 million rupees were accepted.
In the previous auction held on March 27, bids worth 162.25 million rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 16.9401 percent per annum.
